You are resuming a Ralph Workflow PLANNING EDIT MODE session that previously failed twice due to inactivity timeouts. Do NOT restart from scratch — pick up from the most recent state.

CONTEXT FILES TO READ FIRST (in this order), using the mcp__ralph__ file tools (mcp__ralph__read_file etc.) — this is a brokered session, so use ONLY mcp__ralph__* tools for all file/shell/git operations, never native Read/Write/Bash/Edit tools:

1. `.agent/tmp/planning_master_prompt.md` — the binding master prompt for this session (re-read fully).
2. `.agent/PRODUCT_CRITERIA.md` — authoritative task/product criteria (source of truth for the request).
3. `.agent/PLANNING_ANALYSIS_DECISION.md` — authoritative analysis feedback from a fresh reviewer on the current plan.
4. `.agent/tmp/planning_prompt.md` — the original prompt for this task (context only).
5. `/REDACTED_WORKSPACE/.agent/tmp/agent_retry_context_a581a83e79ef41e5a8c4dc229c6b53d2.md` and also try `/REDACTED_WORKSPACE/.agent/tmp/agent_retry_context_3f1c9c7cf92f45a0984631038b97c5fa.md` — retry context summaries from the two prior failed attempts. Read both if they exist; they describe exactly what state the prior attempts reached.
6. Check for an existing draft plan artifact via `mcp__ralph__ralph_get_md_draft` (artifact_type="plan") to see what has already been staged/submitted so far — do not discard or restart it unless it's genuinely absent or empty.
7. Use `mcp__ralph__ralph_index_status` / `mcp__ralph__ralph_reindex` if the index looks cold, and `mcp__ralph__git_status` / `mcp__ralph__git_log` / `mcp__ralph__git_diff` to ground yourself in current repo state.
8. Read `.agent/artifact-formats/plan.md` for the required plan artifact format, and consult the `submit-plan-artifact` skill if useful.

YOUR TASK:
This is PLANNING EDIT MODE. Revise the CURRENT plan artifact using fresh repository evidence plus the analysis feedback in PLANNING_ANALYSIS_DECISION.md. The analysis feedback is advice from a reviewer, not a checklist to blindly satisfy — verify its claims against the actual repository before changing the plan. Follow the Orient → Characterize → Change → Verify structure for each step. Keep valid material from the existing plan; update every commitment that the fresh evidence or feedback affects, together and consistently (don't leave stale cross-references).

Concretely:
- Inspect the repository (via mcp__ralph__ tools only) to verify current file states, behavior, and any commands referenced in the plan.
- Cross-check each point in PLANNING_ANALYSIS_DECISION.md against real evidence (grep/read files, check git log/diff) rather than assuming it's correct.
- Update the plan draft in place using `mcp__ralph__ralph_edit_md_artifact` for targeted changes (preferred), or `mcp__ralph__ralph_stage_md_artifact` with mode="replace_all" only if this genuinely requires a wholesale rewrite.
- If you accept but choose not to act on some feedback, record that reasoning under a `## Validation Overrides` section in the plan, per the master prompt's instructions.
- Validate with `mcp__ralph__ralph_verify_md_artifact` before finalizing if useful.
- Finalize/submit the plan with `mcp__ralph__ralph_submit_md_artifact` (artifact_type="plan") or `mcp__ralph__ralph_finalize_md_artifact` as appropriate, ensuring it is actually submitted (not just staged as a draft).
- This is UNATTENDED MODE: do not ask for confirmation, make reasonable documented assumptions, and complete the work.
- As your FINAL action, call `mcp__ralph__declare_complete`.

Report back: a summary of what the plan revision changed, what analysis feedback was accepted/overridden and why, confirmation the plan artifact was successfully submitted (not left as an unsubmitted draft), and confirmation that declare_complete was called.

- coding-standards: Baseline cross-project coding conventions for naming, readability, immutability, and code-quality review. Use detailed frontend or backend skills for framework-specific patterns.
- dispatching-parallel-agents: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
- executing-plans: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints
- finishing-a-development-branch: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup
- open-design--baseline-ui: Quickly deslop UI code by fixing spacing, hierarchy, typography, and small layout issues. Use when the interface needs a fast cleanup or polish pass.
- open-design--fixing-accessibility: Audit and fix HTML accessibility issues including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, color contrast, and form errors. Use when adding interactive controls, forms, dialogs, or reviewing WCAG compliance.
- open-design--fixing-metadata: Audit and fix HTML metadata including page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph tags, Twitter cards, favicons, JSON-LD structured data, and robots directives. Use when adding SEO metadata, fixing social share previews, reviewing Open Graph tags, setting up canonical URLs, or shipping new pages that need correct meta tags.

Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web, or create slides for a talk/pitch. # Contractor surface — change batch 1

Work the contractor course-plan builder through the spec below. Read `AGENTS.md`
and the policies in `docs/ralph-workflow-policy/` before changing anything, and
use `make verify` as the authoritative gate before claiming any item done.

Each item gives the request **verbatim**, the **decision** taken on it, and
**acceptance criteria**. Where the original request was ambiguous, the decision
records the call and the reasoning. Do not widen scope past these criteria; if
an item turns out to be wrong, say so rather than silently redesigning it.

Two screenshots accompany this batch:

- **Screenshot A** — the course plan builder today: the
  `within 2 weeks students will be able to…` watermark, the course/round context
  line, the milestone and activity boxes, and the current placement of the move
  up / move down / delete controls. Most layout items below describe this screen.
- **Screenshot B** — milestone vs activity type hierarchy, for the font item.

## What already exists (do not rebuild)

Verified in the codebase before writing this spec:

- **Activity minutes already exist.** `course_plan_activities.time_value_min`
  (integer, default 0, not null). `_course_milestone.html.erb` already renders
  `"… min in this milestone"`, and `CoursePlan#recompute_totals!` already
  maintains `course_plan.totals_min` (excluding `synthesis` activities).
- **AI assist already exists.** `app/views/shared/plan_builder/_ai_assist.html.erb`
  — a modal with a plan prompt, Generate, and replace / amend / append apply
  modes, driven by the `plan-ai-assist` Stimulus controller.
- **Move up / Move down / Delete already exist** in `_course_milestone.html.erb`.
- **Plan editability is already governed by status**, not schedule:
  `CoursePlan#editable?` is `draft? || needs_revision?`, enforced in
  `CoursePlanMilestonesController#load_course_plan`.
- **The LLM stack is provider-generic.** `Llm::Client` is the single chat
  transport seam and resolves the active provider at call time from
  `SiteAiSetting` / `OrganizationAiSetting`, so a SUP can switch providers
  without code changes. `SiteAiSetting::SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS` is
  `%w[openai gemini]`, `AiCredential` already holds credentials for both
  (`openai_api_key` / `openai_api_base` and the Vertex AI service-account
  fields), and `LlmModelCatalogEntry` carries a `provider` column. **No item in
  this batch should name or add a specific provider** — anything AI-facing goes
  through the existing seam and works with whichever provider is configured.

## Checklist

### 1. Milestone add / reorder is broken

> **Adding Milestones and moving them up or down in the plan is broken. Please
> make operations …**

The request is cut off mid-sentence. Rather than guess the missing clause, the
behaviour was diagnosed directly. **Three independent root causes**, all real:

1. **Mixed position bases.** `next_position`
   (`CoursePlanMilestonesController:131`) returns `maximum(:position).to_i + 1`,
   so the *first* milestone in a plan gets position **1**. But
   `reorder_milestones!` (:142) and `restore` (:61) renormalise to a **0**-based
   dense index. A never-reordered plan is 1-based; one reorder silently converts
   it to 0-based. The "Move up" disabled check in the view is
   `milestone.position.zero?`, which never fires on a 1-based plan — so the
   first milestone shows an **enabled "Move up" button that does nothing**.
2. **`destroy` never renormalises.** It only sets `discarded_at`
   (:42–50), so positions develop gaps — `[0, 2, 3]`. The view computes
   `position - 1` / `position + 1` from the *stored* position, but
   `reorder_milestones!` treats the incoming number as an *index* into the
   ordered sibling list (`siblings.insert(target, …)`). Once positions have
   gaps, stored position ≠ index, so "Move up" from stored position 2 resolves
   to index 1 — where the milestone already sits. **No-op, or a two-slot jump.**
   `CoursePlanActivitiesController#destroy` has the identical defect.
3. **Turbo-frame lock staleness.** `respond_to_milestone_mutation` (:169)
   re-renders only the mutated milestone's frame, but
   `lock_course_plan_for_mutation` (:103) bumps the parent plan's `lock_version`
   on every successful mutation. Every *other* milestone frame still embeds the
   old `lock_version`, and `verify_course_plan_lock` (:87) rejects any mismatch
   — so the next click on a different milestone 409s with
   **"This plan changed in another session. Reload it and try again."**

**Decision:** make `position` a dense, 0-based index that is authoritative after
every mutation, and stop doing arithmetic on stored positions in the view.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] `next_position` and the renormalise paths agree on a single 0-based
      convention. A plan's positions are always `0..n-1` with no gaps.
- [ ] `destroy` renormalises surviving siblings — milestones **and** activities.
- [ ] Move up / down send the target **index derived from the rendered order**,
      not `stored_position ± 1`.
- [ ] "Move up" is disabled on the first milestone and "Move down" on the last,
      including immediately after a delete.
- [ ] Two consecutive mutations on *different* milestones both succeed with no
      reload — no spurious stale-plan 409.
- [ ] Regression tests cover: reorder after delete, reorder on a fresh plan, and
      back-to-back mutations on different milestones.

### 2. Preround contractor

> **Preround Contractor. Are we in the round or before the round**

**Decision: informational and navigational only — not a second permission gate.**
Plan editability is already governed by plan status. Layering a schedule-based
lock on top creates states where a plan is `draft` (so the UI offers editing)
but blocked for schedule reasons, with no recovery path for the contractor.
Show *where we are*; let status keep deciding *what's allowed*.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Contractor surfaces show whether the round is before start or in progress.
- [ ] The state comes from `Round#student_start_state`
      (`:unknown` / `:future` / `:past`) — do not add a second predicate, and do
      not read `created_at` as schedule data.
- [ ] `:unknown` (no published schedule) renders no preround claim at all.
- [ ] No editing permission changes in this item.

### 3. Watermarks

> **Watermark within 2 weeks students will be able to…** (Screenshot A)
>
> **Also remove the "optional….purpose" watermark.**

The second is `app/views/contractor_course_plans/new.html.erb:34` —
`Optional. State what students will learn or make so the first milestone has a
clear purpose.`

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Both watermarks removed from the course plan surface.
- [ ] Removing helper copy does not orphan an `aria-describedby` reference.

### 4. Ten capture boxes

> **Add an extension on the course plan page or 10 boxes that allow contractors
> to type in, upload or speak/LLM Generate**

**Decision: ten numbered source-material slots on the course plan page, each
accepting typed text, a file upload, or dictation, feeding the existing AI
assist as source material.** Reading "extension … or 10 boxes" as two names for
one feature, and "type in, upload or speak" as three input modes for a single
box rather than three separate features. They feed the existing
`plan_draft` apply pipeline instead of a parallel generator.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Ten slots on the course plan page, each supporting all three input modes.
- [ ] Slots may be left blank; empty slots contribute nothing.
- [ ] Contents feed the existing assist and land through the existing
      replace / amend / append modes.
- [ ] Uploads honour the accept-type and size limits already used by the guide
      import; dictation degrades gracefully where unsupported.
- [ ] Generation goes through the existing `Llm::Client` seam and behaves the
      same under whichever provider the site is configured for. No
      provider-specific branch, no new transport, no new credential fields.
- [ ] An unconfigured or disabled AI provider degrades to a clear message — the
      slots still accept typed text, uploads and dictation.

### 5. Plan builder layout

> **Would prefer the Milestone font bolded and larger than the activity font**
> (Screenshot B)
>
> **`## Biology AM / 2026 Early August — Round 1 — Spring Field Study / AM`
> Make that the light grey**
>
> **Second box is the milestone which expands to the the activities**
>
> **Move move up, move down and delete over to the right.**
>
> **Add Acitivity button that expands and collapses activities**
>
> **Default 1 Milestones and 2 activities that are left blank**

All on `_course_milestone.html.erb` / `_course_activity.html.erb` and the
course-plan show page.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Milestone heading is visibly bolder and larger than activity text.
- [ ] The course / round context line renders light grey.
- [ ] The milestone is the second box and expands to reveal its activities.
- [ ] Move up / Move down / Delete sit right-aligned in their row.
- [ ] "Add Activity" both adds an activity and expands/collapses the list. The
      add form is currently always expanded — it should collapse by default.
- [ ] A new course plan seeds one empty milestone with two empty activities.
- [ ] Seeded blanks do not trip required-field validation before the contractor
      has typed anything, and do not count toward the minutes total.
- [ ] Type styles come from the design system —
      `docs/ralph-workflow-policy/design-system-policy.md`, gate
      `script/design_system_guard.sh`. No ad-hoc font sizes or hex greys.
- [ ] Controls keep their 44px minimum touch target.

### 6. Minutes must meet the course requirement

> **Minutes for activities will equate or surpass total number of minutes
> required for course**

Activity minutes and the plan total already exist. **The only missing piece is
the course-level requirement** — `courses` has no such column.

**Decision: add `courses.required_minutes` (integer, nullable). Warn while
drafting; block at submit-for-approval. Null means no requirement and no gate.**
The requirement belongs to the course, not to one contractor's plan — if each
plan set its own target the constraint would be self-certifying. Blocking every
save would make incremental plan building impossible, so enforcement lands at
the submit gate; null keeps existing courses working unchanged.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] `courses.required_minutes` added, nullable, admin-editable.
- [ ] The plan shows running total vs requirement and the shortfall.
- [ ] `totals_min >= required_minutes` is enforced on submit-for-approval;
      short plans are blocked with a message naming the shortfall.
- [ ] Draft saves are never blocked by this rule.
- [ ] `required_minutes IS NULL` → no warning, no gate.
- [ ] Comparison uses `CoursePlan#recompute_totals!` / `totals_min` — do not
      introduce a second summation with different `synthesis` handling.

### 7. Student tab date filter

> **Under student tab have a date filter which allows contractor to select a
> date and student in order to approve work done while student was absent or
> other instances.**

Lives under `app/views/staff/students/`.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Filter selects a date **and** a student.
- [ ] From the filtered view the contractor can approve work for that date.
- [ ] Approval is scoped to the contractor's assigned courses — reuse the
      existing `ContractorCourseAssignment` authorisation, do not widen it.
- [ ] Backdated approval is attributable: it records who approved, when, and
      the date approved *for*.

## Open risks

- **Screenshots not machine-readable here.** Items 3 and 5 were written from the
  surrounding text. Confirm the exact watermark field and type targets against
  Screenshot A/B before editing.
- **Item 1's truncated clause** may have named a fourth symptom beyond the three
  diagnosed. The three above are confirmed in code; if a fourth shows up, report
  it rather than folding it in silently.
- **Item 4 is the largest item** — three input modes, ten slots, upload and
  dictation handling. If it needs splitting, split it and say so.

## Constraints

- Follow `docs/ralph-workflow-policy/` — `design-system-policy.md` for view
  work, `testing-policy.md` before tests, `typechecking-policy.md` for typed
  code (this codebase is `# typed: strict` Sorbet), `security-policy.md` for new
  input surfaces, `verification-policy.md` before reporting completion.
- Never touch production key material: `.kamal/app_secrets/`, `.kamal/secrets`,
  `.kamal/app_secrets.fingerprints`, `script/prod_secrets_*`, or the
  `PROD-SECRET-GUARD` regions in `Dockerfile` and `config/application.rb`.
- `make verify` is the gate. `make help` lists per-gate targets.

- **Screenshot A** — the course plan builder today: the
  `within 2 weeks students will be able to…` watermark, the course/round context
  line, the milestone and activity boxes, and the current placement of the move
  up / move down / delete controls. Most layout items below describe this screen.
- **Screenshot B** — milestone vs activity type hierarchy, for the font item.

## What already exists (do not rebuild)

Verified in the codebase before writing this spec:

- **Activity minutes already exist.** `course_plan_activities.time_value_min`
  (integer, default 0, not null). `_course_milestone.html.erb` already renders
  `"… min in this milestone"`, and `CoursePlan#recompute_totals!` already
  maintains `course_plan.totals_min` (excluding `synthesis` activities).
- **AI assist already exists.** `app/views/shared/plan_builder/_ai_assist.html.erb`
  — a modal with a plan prompt, Generate, and replace / amend / append apply
  modes, driven by the `plan-ai-assist` Stimulus controller.
- **Move up / Move down / Delete already exist** in `_course_milestone.html.erb`.
- **Plan editability is already governed by status**, not schedule:
  `CoursePlan#editable?` is `draft? || needs_revision?`, enforced in
  `CoursePlanMilestonesController#load_course_plan`.
- **The LLM stack is provider-generic.** `Llm::Client` is the single chat
  transport seam and resolves the active provider at call time from
  `SiteAiSetting` / `OrganizationAiSetting`, so a SUP can switch providers
  without code changes. `SiteAiSetting::SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS` is
  `%w[openai gemini]`, `AiCredential` already holds credentials for both
  (`openai_api_key` / `openai_api_base` and the Vertex AI service-account
  fields), and `LlmModelCatalogEntry` carries a `provider` column. **No item in
  this batch should name or add a specific provider** — anything AI-facing goes
  through the existing seam and works with whichever provider is configured.

## Checklist

### 1. Milestone add / reorder is broken

> **Adding Milestones and moving them up or down in the plan is broken. Please
> make operations …**

The request is cut off mid-sentence. Rather than guess the missing clause, the
behaviour was diagnosed directly. **Three independent root causes**, all real:

1. **Mixed position bases.** `next_position`
   (`CoursePlanMilestonesController:131`) returns `maximum(:position).to_i + 1`,
   so the *first* milestone in a plan gets position **1**. But
   `reorder_milestones!` (:142) and `restore` (:61) renormalise to a **0**-based
   dense index. A never-reordered plan is 1-based; one reorder silently converts
   it to 0-based. The "Move up" disabled check in the view is
   `milestone.position.zero?`, which never fires on a 1-based plan — so the
   first milestone shows an **enabled "Move up" button that does nothing**.
2. **`destroy` never renormalises.** It only sets `discarded_at`
   (:42–50), so positions develop gaps — `[0, 2, 3]`. The view computes
   `position - 1` / `position + 1` from the *stored* position, but
   `reorder_milestones!` treats the incoming number as an *index* into the
   ordered sibling list (`siblings.insert(target, …)`). Once positions have
   gaps, stored position ≠ index, so "Move up" from stored position 2 resolves
   to index 1 — where the milestone already sits. **No-op, or a two-slot jump.**
   `CoursePlanActivitiesController#destroy` has the identical defect.
3. **Turbo-frame lock staleness.** `respond_to_milestone_mutation` (:169)
   re-renders only the mutated milestone's frame, but
   `lock_course_plan_for_mutation` (:103) bumps the parent plan's `lock_version`
   on every successful mutation. Every *other* milestone frame still embeds the
   old `lock_version`, and `verify_course_plan_lock` (:87) rejects any mismatch
   — so the next click on a different milestone 409s with
   **"This plan changed in another session. Reload it and try again."**

**Decision:** make `position` a dense, 0-based index that is authoritative after
every mutation, and stop doing arithmetic on stored positions in the view.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] `next_position` and the renormalise paths agree on a single 0-based
      convention. A plan's positions are always `0..n-1` with no gaps.
- [ ] `destroy` renormalises surviving siblings — milestones **and** activities.
- [ ] Move up / down send the target **index derived from the rendered order**,
      not `stored_position ± 1`.
- [ ] "Move up" is disabled on the first milestone and "Move down" on the last,
      including immediately after a delete.
- [ ] Two consecutive mutations on *different* milestones both succeed with no
      reload — no spurious stale-plan 409.
- [ ] Regression tests cover: reorder after delete, reorder on a fresh plan, and
      back-to-back mutations on different milestones.

### 2. Preround contractor

> **Preround Contractor. Are we in the round or before the round**

**Decision: informational and navigational only — not a second permission gate.**
Plan editability is already governed by plan status. Layering a schedule-based
lock on top creates states where a plan is `draft` (so the UI offers editing)
but blocked for schedule reasons, with no recovery path for the contractor.
Show *where we are*; let status keep deciding *what's allowed*.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Contractor surfaces show whether the round is before start or in progress.
- [ ] The state comes from `Round#student_start_state`
      (`:unknown` / `:future` / `:past`) — do not add a second predicate, and do
      not read `created_at` as schedule data.
- [ ] `:unknown` (no published schedule) renders no preround claim at all.
- [ ] No editing permission changes in this item.

### 3. Watermarks

> **Watermark within 2 weeks students will be able to…** (Screenshot A)
>
> **Also remove the "optional….purpose" watermark.**

The second is `app/views/contractor_course_plans/new.html.erb:34` —
`Optional. State what students will learn or make so the first milestone has a
clear purpose.`

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Both watermarks removed from the course plan surface.
- [ ] Removing helper copy does not orphan an `aria-describedby` reference.

### 4. Ten capture boxes

> **Add an extension on the course plan page or 10 boxes that allow contractors
> to type in, upload or speak/LLM Generate**

**Decision: ten numbered source-material slots on the course plan page, each
accepting typed text, a file upload, or dictation, feeding the existing AI
assist as source material.** Reading "extension … or 10 boxes" as two names for
one feature, and "type in, upload or speak" as three input modes for a single
box rather than three separate features. They feed the existing
`plan_draft` apply pipeline instead of a parallel generator.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Ten slots on the course plan page, each supporting all three input modes.
- [ ] Slots may be left blank; empty slots contribute nothing.
- [ ] Contents feed the existing assist and land through the existing
      replace / amend / append modes.
- [ ] Uploads honour the accept-type and size limits already used by the guide
      import; dictation degrades gracefully where unsupported.
- [ ] Generation goes through the existing `Llm::Client` seam and behaves the
      same under whichever provider the site is configured for. No
      provider-specific branch, no new transport, no new credential fields.
- [ ] An unconfigured or disabled AI provider degrades to a clear message — the
      slots still accept typed text, uploads and dictation.

### 5. Plan builder layout

> **Would prefer the Milestone font bolded and larger than the activity font**
> (Screenshot B)
>
> **`## Biology AM / 2026 Early August — Round 1 — Spring Field Study / AM`
> Make that the light grey**
>
> **Second box is the milestone which expands to the the activities**
>
> **Move move up, move down and delete over to the right.**
>
> **Add Acitivity button that expands and collapses activities**
>
> **Default 1 Milestones and 2 activities that are left blank**

All on `_course_milestone.html.erb` / `_course_activity.html.erb` and the
course-plan show page.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Milestone heading is visibly bolder and larger than activity text.
- [ ] The course / round context line renders light grey.
- [ ] The milestone is the second box and expands to reveal its activities.
- [ ] Move up / Move down / Delete sit right-aligned in their row.
- [ ] "Add Activity" both adds an activity and expands/collapses the list. The
      add form is currently always expanded — it should collapse by default.
- [ ] A new course plan seeds one empty milestone with two empty activities.
- [ ] Seeded blanks do not trip required-field validation before the contractor
      has typed anything, and do not count toward the minutes total.
- [ ] Type styles come from the design system —
      `docs/ralph-workflow-policy/design-system-policy.md`, gate
      `script/design_system_guard.sh`. No ad-hoc font sizes or hex greys.
- [ ] Controls keep their 44px minimum touch target.

### 6. Minutes must meet the course requirement

> **Minutes for activities will equate or surpass total number of minutes
> required for course**

Activity minutes and the plan total already exist. **The only missing piece is
the course-level requirement** — `courses` has no such column.

**Decision: add `courses.required_minutes` (integer, nullable). Warn while
drafting; block at submit-for-approval. Null means no requirement and no gate.**
The requirement belongs to the course, not to one contractor's plan — if each
plan set its own target the constraint would be self-certifying. Blocking every
save would make incremental plan building impossible, so enforcement lands at
the submit gate; null keeps existing courses working unchanged.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] `courses.required_minutes` added, nullable, admin-editable.
- [ ] The plan shows running total vs requirement and the shortfall.
- [ ] `totals_min >= required_minutes` is enforced on submit-for-approval;
      short plans are blocked with a message naming the shortfall.
- [ ] Draft saves are never blocked by this rule.
- [ ] `required_minutes IS NULL` → no warning, no gate.
- [ ] Comparison uses `CoursePlan#recompute_totals!` / `totals_min` — do not
      introduce a second summation with different `synthesis` handling.

### 7. Student tab date filter

> **Under student tab have a date filter which allows contractor to select a
> date and student in order to approve work done while student was absent or
> other instances.**

Lives under `app/views/staff/students/`.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Filter selects a date **and** a student.
- [ ] From the filtered view the contractor can approve work for that date.
- [ ] Approval is scoped to the contractor's assigned courses — reuse the
      existing `ContractorCourseAssignment` authorisation, do not widen it.
- [ ] Backdated approval is attributable: it records who approved, when, and
      the date approved *for*.

## Open risks

- **Screenshots not machine-readable here.** Items 3 and 5 were written from the
  surrounding text. Confirm the exact watermark field and type targets against
  Screenshot A/B before editing.
- **Item 1's truncated clause** may have named a fourth symptom beyond the three
  diagnosed. The three above are confirmed in code; if a fourth shows up, report
  it rather than folding it in silently.
- **Item 4 is the largest item** — three input modes, ten slots, upload and
  dictation handling. If it needs splitting, split it and say so.

## Constraints

- Follow `docs/ralph-workflow-policy/` — `design-system-policy.md` for view
  work, `testing-policy.md` before tests, `typechecking-policy.md` for typed
  code (this codebase is `# typed: strict` Sorbet), `security-policy.md` for new
  input surfaces, `verification-policy.md` before reporting completion.
- Never touch production key material: `.kamal/app_secrets/`, `.kamal/secrets`,
  `.kamal/app_secrets.fingerprints`, `script/prod_secrets_*`, or the
  `PROD-SECRET-GUARD` regions in `Dockerfile` and `config/application.rb`.
- `make verify` is the gate. `make help` lists per-gate targets.

## Summary

- [SUM-1] The plan is well characterized overall, but two proven execution gaps leave required mutation and backdated-approval flows unresolved.

## What Came Up Short

- [PA-001] Observation: S-1 defers the known Turbo lock failure to a regression test (“confirm ... whether”); the controllers prove it cannot be fixed by position normalization: every mutation compares the submitted parent lock_version, then advances it, while a Turbo response re-renders only the mutated milestone/activity frame. Cost: the required consecutive mutations on different frames will still return stale-plan 409, so an executor can complete the listed position work without meeting Item 1. Fix: replace the conditional investigation with a concrete response strategy that updates every remaining mutation frame’s lock_version after each successful Turbo mutation (and name the affected milestone/activity response paths and regression tests).
- [PA-002] Observation: S-7 names the approval action and attribution storage as TBD, although the existing route is unusable for the requested contractor flow: ReviewPassesController#create returns forbidden unless the role is men/dex, its sanitize_filters drops date, and Staff::StudentsController#validated_schedule_origin also rejects date. Cost: a date selected on Students cannot survive into the approval pass, and a contractor cannot approve through the only named current path, so the plan provides no executable, authorized route to Item 7’s required dated approval or attribution. Fix: replace S-7’s TBD bullets with the selected controller/route and persistence design, explicitly extend or replace the review-pass authorization with ContractorCourseAssignment-scoped contractor access, carry and validate date through effective_roster_filters, validated_schedule_origin, ReviewPassesController#sanitize_filters, and unit selection, and add positive/negative authorization plus date-attribution tests.

## How To Fix

- [PA-001] Rewrite the S-1 Turbo-frame bullet and its Files/tests list to require the chosen all-live-frame lock-version refresh in both controllers, then prove two distinct existing frames mutate successfully without reload.
- [PA-002] Rewrite S-7 with the concrete dated-approval endpoint/model fields and the full filter/authorization propagation path, then name focused tests that prove a contractor can approve only assigned-course work for the selected date and that the recorded approver, timestamp, and approved-for date are correct.

## Plan the work before the paperwork

Inspect the request and repository before writing the plan. Ground claims about files, behavior, commands, and patterns in evidence; turn unknowns into a discovery step rather than guesses.

Plan the full arc in this order, even for easy-looking work:

1. **Orient** — identify the requested outcome, relevant code, and constraints.
2. **Characterize** — establish current behavior with evidence.
3. **Change** — name the smallest concrete edits and dependencies.
4. **Verify** — name runnable proof for the outcome.

Keep commitments next to the step they describe and state each one once.

*** UNATTENDED MODE - AUTONOMOUS DELIVERY ***

Proceed independently from the available evidence: make a reasonable assumption when needed, record it when it affects the result, and finish the assigned work.

Do not ask the user for confirmation; this run has no interactive response path. Put only instructed artifacts under `.agent/`; do not write status `.md` files unless requested.

Capabilities:
  - artifact.plan_read
  - artifact.plan_write
  - artifact.submit
  - git.diff_read
  - git.status_read
  - media.read
  - process.exec_bounded
  - web.search

  - workspace.metadata_read

These define the brokered operations Ralph Workflow authorizes. Treat actions outside
them as prohibited even when a particular runtime cannot technically hide all
native tools.

MCP TOOLS (Ralph Workflow Brokered)

Use Ralph Workflow's MCP tools for file and shell operations in this brokered session. Availability varies by runtime: use only the brokered
tools from the exact rendered name below. Tool names are callable identifiers,
not shell commands.

READ / SEARCH: `mcp__ralph__read_file`, `mcp__ralph__read_multiple_files`, `mcp__ralph__stat_path`, `mcp__ralph__list_allowed_roots`, `mcp__ralph__list_directory`, `mcp__ralph__list_directory_recursive`, `mcp__ralph__directory_tree`, `mcp__ralph__search_files`, `mcp__ralph__grep_files` (indexed; FTS5 path is correct-by-default)
Use these for every workspace read or search; native shell/file commands must not be used to read or search the workspace.

WEB / MEDIA: `mcp__ralph__web_search`, `mcp__ralph__visit_url`

ARTIFACT SUBMISSION:
- Use `mcp__ralph__ralph_submit_md_artifact` to submit an artifact: pass `artifact_type` and `content` (the complete markdown document per its `.agent/artifact-formats/<type>.md` format doc)
- Use `mcp__ralph__ralph_verify_md_artifact` to validate an artifact document without persisting it (read-only; same arguments; returns line/section/rule-anchored diagnostics)
- For long documents, stage incrementally: `mcp__ralph__ralph_stage_md_artifact` appends (or `mode="replace_all"` replaces) draft content, `mcp__ralph__ralph_get_md_draft` returns the draft with diagnostics, `mcp__ralph__ralph_finalize_md_artifact` validates and submits the assembled draft (the draft is retained either way), `mcp__ralph__ralph_discard_md_draft` drops the draft for a genuine wholesale restart only — never to recover from validation errors or to make a revision substantially similar to the draft, which throws the document away and forces a full retype
- Every submission stages its document as that artifact's draft, valid or not. To fix validation errors, edit the draft in place with `mcp__ralph__ralph_edit_md_artifact`: pass `artifact_type` and `edits` (a list of `oldText`/`newText` pairs applied by sequential first-occurrence replacement, all-or-nothing if any `oldText` is missing). Use `dry_run` to preview the diff. Do NOT resend the whole document to change part of it.
- `mcp__ralph__ralph_edit_md_artifact` IS a submission: it is `mcp__ralph__ralph_submit_md_artifact` starting from the existing draft, and it submits the artifact canonically as soon as the edited draft validates — no separate `mcp__ralph__ralph_finalize_md_artifact` call. If the edited draft still has errors it is kept as a draft for further repair and nothing is submitted; the response reports `submitted` either way. Submitting does not end the phase, so a later edit in the same attempt simply resubmits.
- To revise a submitted or staged document: inspect it with `mcp__ralph__ralph_get_md_draft`, then apply `mcp__ralph__ralph_edit_md_artifact` edits. Replacing the whole document via `mcp__ralph__ralph_stage_md_artifact` (`mode="replace_all"`) is the fallback when a rewrite really is wholesale — not for a revision whose content is substantially similar to the draft.

- Use `mcp__ralph__declare_complete` when finished

Tip: Configuring arabold/docs-mcp-server on localhost:6280 in .agent/mcp.toml improves documentation lookup quality during planning.

## Plan submission

The plan format guide at `.agent/artifact-formats/plan.md` offers a useful
default structure; it does not require a uniform document. A step may use
`### [S-n] Title`; IDs are stable and never renumbered when your plan needs
them. Use `Type: verify` for a test-running step when useful; step types are
preserved verbatim. `PLAN001` is the only blocking plan diagnostic: the submission is empty, too short, or plainly
not a plan. Warnings and info are advice. Record a normal, reasoned decision
to proceed past advice under `## Validation Overrides`; tool results retain
those reasons.

(`artifact_type="plan"`). For a similar revision, use

validates. Use `mcp__ralph__ralph_stage_md_artifact` with `mode="replace_all"`
only for a wholesale rewrite. `mcp__ralph__ralph_get_md_draft` shows the draft,
and `mcp__ralph__ralph_finalize_md_artifact` submits an assembled staged draft.
Staging alone does not persist a plan: a draft that differs from the submitted
document blocks phase completion until you resubmit it or deliberately discard
it with `ralph_discard_md_draft`. Do not write canonical plan files directly. After a valid receipt, call
`mcp__ralph__declare_complete` as the final action.

# typed: strict

class CoursePlanMilestonesController < ApplicationController
  extend T::Sig

  before_action :load_course_plan
  before_action :load_milestone, only: %i[update destroy reorder]
  around_action :lock_course_plan_for_mutation
  rescue_from ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError, with: :render_stale_plan

  sig { void }
  def create
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    milestone = course_plan.course_plan_milestones.build(milestone_params.merge(position: next_position))

    if milestone.save
      respond_to_milestone_mutation(course_plan, milestone, "Milestone added.")
    elsif turbo_frame_request?
      render_milestone_errors(course_plan, milestone)
    else
      flash[:course_plan_milestone_title_attempt] = milestone.title.to_s
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan), alert: milestone.errors.full_messages.to_sentence
    end
  end

  sig { void }
  def update
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    milestone = T.must(@milestone)
    milestone.assign_attributes(milestone_params)

    if milestone.save
      respond_to_milestone_mutation(course_plan, milestone, "Milestone updated.")
    elsif turbo_frame_request?
      render_milestone_errors(course_plan, milestone)
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-milestone-#{milestone.id}"), alert: milestone.errors.full_messages.to_sentence
    end
  end

  sig { void }
  def destroy
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    milestone = T.must(@milestone)
    discarded_at = Time.current
    milestone.update!(discarded_at:)
    CoursePlanActivity.where(course_plan_milestone_id: milestone.id, discarded_at: nil).update_all(discarded_at:, cascade_discarded_at: discarded_at)
    course_plan.recompute_totals!
    redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan), notice: "Milestone removed.", alert: nil
  end

  sig { void }
  def restore
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    milestone = CoursePlanMilestone.unscoped.where(course_plan: course_plan).find_by(id: params[:id], discarded_at: ..Time.current)
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless milestone

    cascade_marker = milestone.discarded_at
    milestone.update!(discarded_at: nil)
    CoursePlanActivity.where(course_plan_milestone_id: milestone.id, cascade_discarded_at: cascade_marker).update_all(discarded_at: nil, cascade_discarded_at: nil)
    course_plan.course_plan_milestones.reorder(:position, :id).each_with_index do |sibling, index|
      sibling.update_columns(position: index)
    end
    course_plan.recompute_totals!
    redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-milestone-#{milestone.id}"), notice: "Milestone restored."
  end


  sig { void }
  def reorder
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    milestone = T.must(@milestone)
    reorder_milestones!(milestone, requested_position)
    redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-milestone-#{milestone.id}"), notice: "Milestone reordered."
  end

  private

  sig { void }
  def load_course_plan
    @course_plan = T.let(authorize_course_plan(params[:course_plan_id]), T.nilable(CoursePlan))
    course_plan = @course_plan
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless course_plan && (course_plan.draft? || course_plan.needs_revision?)
  end

  sig { void }
  def verify_course_plan_lock
    raw_lock_version = params[:lock_version].to_s
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    # DA-006 — a missing or empty lock_version is rejected for
    # EVERY mutation, including create/destroy/reorder/duplicate/
    # reassign/restore. The prior "skip when empty and not
    # update" exception let stale create/destroy requests race in
    # against the latest plan and overwrite newer edits; we now
    # require the parent lock version on every child write.
    if raw_lock_version.empty?
      raise ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError.new(course_plan, action_name.to_s)
    end
    raise ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError.new(course_plan, action_name.to_s) unless raw_lock_version.match?(/\A\d+\z/) && raw_lock_version.to_i == course_plan.lock_version
  end

  sig { params(action: T.proc.void).void }
  def lock_course_plan_for_mutation(&action)
    course_plan = T.must(@course_plan)
    course_plan.with_lock do
      verify_course_plan_lock
      initial_lock_version = course_plan.lock_version
      action.call
      course_plan.reload
      course_plan.touch if (response.successful? || response.redirect?) && course_plan.lock_version == initial_lock_version
    end
  end

  sig { void }
  def load_milestone
    @milestone = T.let(T.must(@course_plan).course_plan_milestones.find_by(id: params[:id]), T.nilable(CoursePlanMilestone))
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound unless @milestone
  end

  sig { params(id: Object).returns(T.nilable(CoursePlan)) }
  def authorize_course_plan(id)
    actor = current_user || raise(ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound)
    site = current_active_site || raise(ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound)
    return nil unless current_active_role == :con

    CoursePlan.where(site: site, author: actor,
                     course_id: ContractorCourseAssignment.where(contractor_user: actor, site: site).select(:course_id)).find_by(id: id)
  end

  sig { returns(Integer) }
  def next_position
    T.must(@course_plan).course_plan_milestones.maximum(:position).to_i + 1
  end

  sig { returns(Integer) }
  def requested_position
    raw_position = params[:position].to_s
    raw_position.match?(/\A\d+\z/) ? raw_position.to_i : T.must(@milestone).position
  end

  sig { params(milestone: CoursePlanMilestone, position: Integer).void }
  def reorder_milestones!(milestone, position)
    milestone.class.transaction do
      siblings = T.must(@course_plan).course_plan_milestones.reorder(:position, :id).to_a
      target = position.clamp(0, siblings.length - 1)
      siblings.delete(milestone)
      siblings.insert(target, milestone)
      siblings.each_with_index { |sibling, index| sibling.update_columns(position: index) }
    end
  end

  sig { params(_error: ActiveRecord::StaleObjectError).void }
  def render_stale_plan(_error)
    return if performed?

    if turbo_frame_request?
      render partial: "shared/plan_builder/stale_mutation", locals: { course_plan: T.must(@course_plan), frame_id: request.headers.fetch("Turbo-Frame") }, status: :conflict
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(T.must(@course_plan)), alert: "This plan changed in another session. Reload it and try again.", status: :conflict
    end
  end

  sig { returns(T::Boolean) }
  def turbo_frame_request?
    request.headers["Turbo-Frame"].present?
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, milestone: CoursePlanMilestone, notice: String).void }
  def respond_to_milestone_mutation(course_plan, milestone, notice)
    if turbo_frame_request?
      # Keep the returned milestone frame usable for its next mutation by
      # rendering its hidden lock version after advancing the parent plan.
      prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
      render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone", locals: { course_plan:, milestone:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user), notice: }
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-milestone-#{milestone.id}"), notice:
    end
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan).void }
  def prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
    course_plan.reload
    course_plan.touch
    course_plan.reload
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, milestone: CoursePlanMilestone).void }
  def render_milestone_errors(course_plan, milestone)
    render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone", locals: { course_plan:, milestone:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user) }, status: :unprocessable_entity
  end

  sig { returns(ActionController::Parameters) }
  def milestone_params
    params.require(:course_plan_milestone).permit(:title, :product)
  end
end

    if turbo_frame_request?

    end
  end

  def prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
    course_plan.reload
    course_plan.touch
    course_plan.reload
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
  def render_activity_update_errors(course_plan, activity)
    render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_activity", locals: { course_plan:, milestone: T.must(@milestone), activity:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user) }, status: :unprocessable_entity
  end

  sig { returns(ActionController::Parameters) }
  def activity_params
    params.require(:course_plan_activity).permit(:title, :description, :time_value_min)
  end

      render partial: "shared/plan_builder/stale_mutation", locals: { course_plan: T.must(@course_plan), frame_id: request.headers.fetch("Turbo-Frame") }, status: :conflict
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(T.must(@course_plan)), alert: "This plan changed in another session. Reload it and try again.", status: :conflict
    end
  end

  sig { returns(T::Boolean) }
  def turbo_frame_request?
    request.headers["Turbo-Frame"].present?
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
  def respond_to_activity_create(course_plan, activity)
    if turbo_frame_request?
      prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
      render turbo_stream: turbo_stream_builder.replace(
        "course-plan-milestone-frame-#{T.must(@milestone).id}",
        partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone",
        locals: {
          course_plan:,
          milestone: T.must(@milestone).reload,
          presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user),
          notice: "Activity added."
        }
      )
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-activity-#{activity.id}"), notice: "Activity added."
    end
  end

  # DA-002 — typed wrapper around `Turbo::Streams::TagBuilder` so Sorbet can
  # resolve the `.replace(...)` call below (the bare `turbo_stream` helper
  # exposed by `Turbo::StreamsHelper` is not on this controller's RBI
  # surface). Mirrors the same pattern in
  # PlanSourceGuidesController#turbo_stream_builder,
  # EvidenceArtifactsController#turbo_stream_builder, and
  # PlanMilestonesController#turbo_stream_builder; it is the single typed
  # boundary for emitting Turbo Streams from any Sorbet-strict controller.
  sig { returns(Turbo::Streams::TagBuilder) }
  def turbo_stream_builder
    Turbo::Streams::TagBuilder.new(view_context)
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
  def respond_to_activity_update(course_plan, activity)
    if turbo_frame_request?
      # The returned card becomes the user's next mutation surface. Advance
      # the parent version before rendering it, otherwise its hidden
      # lock_version is stale as soon as the around action touches the plan.
      prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
      render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_activity", locals: { course_plan:, milestone: T.must(@milestone), activity:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user), notice: "Activity updated." }
    else
      redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-activity-#{activity.id}"), notice: "Activity updated."
    end
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan).void }
  def prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
    course_plan.reload
    course_plan.touch
    course_plan.reload
  end

  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
  def render_activity_update_errors(course_plan, activity)
    render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_activity", locals: { course_plan:, milestone: T.must(@milestone), activity:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user) }, status: :unprocessable_entity
  end

  sig { returns(ActionController::Parameters) }
  def activity_params
    params.require(:course_plan_activity).permit(:title, :description, :time_value_min)
  end
end

content.text:
<% course_plan = presenter.course_plan! %>
<%= render "shared/plan_builder/plan_kind_badge", label: presenter.plan_kind_label %>

<%= presenter.course_flow_help %>

Total minutes: <%= course_plan.totals_min %>. <%= presenter.minutes_help %>

<%= render AiCommentaryComponent.new(commentable: course_plan) %> <% if course_plan.editable? %> <%= form_with model: course_plan, url: support_course_plan_path(course_plan), method: :patch, class: "card surface-panel", data: { controller: "planning-mutation", action: "input->planning-mutation#dirty submit->planning-mutation#guard turbo:submit-start->planning-mutation#start turbo:submit-end->planning-mutation#finish" }, aria: { busy: false } do |form| %>

Saved at <%= course_plan.updated_at.in_time_zone.strftime("%H:%M") %>

<%= form.hidden_field :lock_version %>
<% title_error_id = "course-plan-title-error" if course_plan.errors[:title].any? %>
<%= form.label :title, presenter.title_label, class: "label" %><%= form.text_field :title, class: "input field-control w-full min-h-[44px]", aria: { invalid: course_plan.errors[:title].any?, describedby: title_error_id } %><% if title_error_id %>

<%= course_plan.errors.full_messages_for(:title).to_sentence %>

<% end %>
<% goal_error_id = "course-plan-goal-error" if course_plan.errors[:goal].any? %>
<%= form.label :goal, presenter.goal_label, class: "label" %><%= form.text_area :goal, class: "textarea field-control w-full", aria: { invalid: course_plan.errors[:goal].any?, describedby: [ "course-plan-goal-help", goal_error_id ].compact.join(" ") } %>

<%= presenter.goal_help %>

<% if goal_error_id %>

<%= course_plan.errors.full_messages_for(:goal).to_sentence %>

<% end %>
<%= form.submit "Save changes", class: "btn btn-secondary min-h-[44px]" %>
<% end %> <%= render "shared/plan_builder/ai_assist", presenter: presenter %> <% end %> <% if course_plan.course_plan_milestones.any? %>

Milestones and activities

Sequence markers show the activity order within each milestone.

<% course_plan.course_plan_milestones.each do |milestone| %> <%= render "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone", course_plan: course_plan, milestone: milestone, presenter: presenter %> <% end %>
<% elsif course_plan.editable? %>

Start with a milestone

Add the first milestone below, then add activities that build toward its product.

<% end %> <% if course_plan.editable? %> <% discarded_activity = CoursePlanActivity.unscoped.joins(:course_plan_milestone).where(course_plan: course_plan, course_plan_milestones: { discarded_at: nil }).where.not(discarded_at: nil).order(discarded_at: :desc, id: :desc).first %> <% if discarded_activity %><%= button_to "Undo remove #{discarded_activity.title}", restore_support_course_plan_milestone_activity_path(course_plan, discarded_activity.course_plan_milestone_id, discarded_activity), params: { lock_version: course_plan.lock_version }, class: "btn btn-outline min-h-[44px]", form: { data: { controller: "planning-mutation", action: "submit->planning-mutation#guard turbo:submit-start->planning-mutation#start turbo:submit-end->planning-mutation#finish" } } %><% end %> <% discarded_milestone = CoursePlanMilestone.unscoped.where(course_plan: course_plan).where.not(discarded_at: nil).order(discarded_at: :desc, id: :desc).first %> <% if discarded_milestone %><%= button_to "Undo remove #{discarded_milestone.title}", restore_support_course_plan_milestone_path(course_plan, discarded_milestone), params: { lock_version: course_plan.lock_version }, class: "btn btn-outline min-h-[44px]", form: { data: { controller: "planning-mutation", action: "submit->planning-mutation#guard turbo:submit-start->planning-mutation#start turbo:submit-end->planning-mutation#finish" } } %><% end %> <%= form_with url: support_course_plan_milestones_path(course_plan), class: "card surface-panel", data: { controller: "planning-mutation", action: "input->planning-mutation#dirty submit->planning-mutation#guard turbo:submit-start->planning-mutation#start turbo:submit-end->planning-mutation#finish" }, aria: { busy: false } do %>

<%= hidden_field_tag :lock_version, course_plan.lock_version %>

Add milestone

<%= presenter.milestone_help %>

<%= label_tag "course_plan_milestone_title", "Milestone name", class: "label" %> <%= text_field_tag "course_plan_milestone[title]", flash[:course_plan_milestone_title_attempt], class: "input field-control w-full min-h-[44px]", required: true %> <%= submit_tag "Add milestone", class: "btn btn-secondary min-h-[44px]" %>
<% end %> <% end %>

commit 7336e6c8ffdc75e869c418b83456ddba7fb14501
Author: Mistlight <mistlight@otakukingdom.com>
Date:   Sun Aug 2 06:25:43 2026 +0000

    fix(course-plans): refresh turbo lock versions after mutations
    
    Advance and reload the parent course plan before rendering successful Turbo milestone and activity frames so their hidden lock versions support the next update without a stale-object failure.
    
    Co-authored-by: Ralph Workflow <noreply@ralphworkflow.com>

diff --git a/app/controllers/course_plan_activities_controller.rb b/app/controllers/course_plan_activities_controller.rb
index b81688b4..807028c6 100644
--- a/app/controllers/course_plan_activities_controller.rb
+++ b/app/controllers/course_plan_activities_controller.rb
@@ -214,12 +214,23 @@ class CoursePlanActivitiesController < ApplicationController
   sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
   def respond_to_activity_update(course_plan, activity)
     if turbo_frame_request?
+      # The returned card becomes the user's next mutation surface. Advance
+      # the parent version before rendering it, otherwise its hidden
+      # lock_version is stale as soon as the around action touches the plan.
+      prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
       render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_activity", locals: { course_plan:, milestone: T.must(@milestone), activity:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user), notice: "Activity updated." }
     else
       redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-activity-#{activity.id}"), notice: "Activity updated."
     end
   end
 
+  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan).void }
+  def prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
+    course_plan.reload
+    course_plan.touch
+    course_plan.reload
+  end
+
   sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, activity: CoursePlanActivity).void }
   def render_activity_update_errors(course_plan, activity)
     render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_activity", locals: { course_plan:, milestone: T.must(@milestone), activity:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user) }, status: :unprocessable_entity
diff --git a/app/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller.rb b/app/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller.rb
index b5b0cad8..fd42a214 100644
--- a/app/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller.rb
+++ b/app/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller.rb
@@ -158,12 +158,22 @@ class CoursePlanMilestonesController < ApplicationController
   sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, milestone: CoursePlanMilestone, notice: String).void }
   def respond_to_milestone_mutation(course_plan, milestone, notice)
     if turbo_frame_request?
+      # Keep the returned milestone frame usable for its next mutation by
+      # rendering its hidden lock version after advancing the parent plan.
+      prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
       render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone", locals: { course_plan:, milestone:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user), notice: }
     else
       redirect_to support_course_plan_path(course_plan, anchor: "course-plan-milestone-#{milestone.id}"), notice:
     end
   end
 
+  sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan).void }
+  def prepare_turbo_success!(course_plan)
+    course_plan.reload
+    course_plan.touch
+    course_plan.reload
+  end
+
   sig { params(course_plan: CoursePlan, milestone: CoursePlanMilestone).void }
   def render_milestone_errors(course_plan, milestone)
     render partial: "shared/plan_builder/course_milestone", locals: { course_plan:, milestone:, presenter: PlanBuilderPresenter.new(plan: course_plan, variant: :course, current_user: current_user) }, status: :unprocessable_entity
diff --git a/test/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller_test.rb b/test/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller_test.rb
index 70af9264..d046b032 100644
--- a/test/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller_test.rb
+++ b/test/controllers/course_plan_milestones_controller_test.rb
@@ -108,6 +108,16 @@ class CoursePlanMilestonesControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
     assert_equal "Revised interview", activity.reload.title
     assert_equal 45, plan.reload.totals_min
     assert_select "turbo-frame#course-plan-activity-frame-#{activity.id}"
+    returned_lock_version = response.body[/name="lock_version"[^>]*value="(\d+)"/, 1]
+    assert_equal plan.reload.lock_version.to_s, returned_lock_version,
+                 "a successful Turbo response must carry the new parent lock version"
+
+    patch support_course_plan_milestone_activity_path(plan, milestone, activity),
+          params: { course_plan_activity: { title: "Saved again", description: "Prepared questions", time_value_min: 50 }, lock_version: returned_lock_version },
+          headers: { "Turbo-Frame" => "course-plan-activity-frame-#{activity.id}" }
+
+    assert_response :success
+    assert_equal "Saved again", activity.reload.title
     assert_select "[data-test='course-plan-activity-status'][role='status']", text: "Activity updated."
   end
 
@@ -226,6 +236,16 @@ class CoursePlanMilestonesControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
 
     assert_response :success
     assert_equal "Recovered milestone", milestone.reload.title
+    returned_lock_version = response.body[/name="lock_version"[^>]*value="(\d+)"/, 1]
+    assert_equal plan.reload.lock_version.to_s, returned_lock_version,
+                 "a successful Turbo response must carry the new parent lock version"
+
+    patch support_course_plan_milestone_path(plan, milestone),
+          params: { course_plan_milestone: { title: "Saved milestone again", product: "Retained product" }, lock_version: returned_lock_version },
+          headers: { "Turbo-Frame" => "course-plan-milestone-frame-#{milestone.id}" }
+
+    assert_response :success
+    assert_equal "Saved milestone again", milestone.reload.title
   end
 
   test "rejects a stale milestone update without changing the milestone" do
