# typed: strict

# WT-09 / S-6 — Review pass controller for sequential decision
# flow on the mentor surfaces (Students → pick a student and a
# review type → decide → next).
#
# A pass is opened (POST /review_passes) by the roster heading
# (column-name with the count, opens every waiting student in
# the current filter+sort) or by the signoff list
# `Review readiness ({n})` heading control (readiness pass
# over the current filter+sort). Decision URLs carry the pass
# id; the existing decision endpoints use the pass id to know
# which unit comes next.
#
# Authorization scope: MEN / DEX only. SUP is rejected (RC-65
# operational-inspection branch is read-only). CON / STU are
# bounced to /denied. The pass id is treated as opaque to
# callers (no enumeration); the controller loads it by id and
# verifies ownership against `current_user.id` so a mentor
# cannot poke another mentor's pass.
class ReviewPassesController < ApplicationController
  extend T::Sig

  ALLOWED_ORIGINS = T.let(%w[students_heading students_cell signoff_heading direct cell_pass].freeze, T::Array[String])
  ALLOWED_REVIEW_TYPES = T.let(%w[plan evidence final_product readiness].freeze, T::Array[String])
  ALLOWED_RETURN_PATHS = T.let(%w[/students /signoff /review/plans /review/evidence /review/final-products].freeze, T::Array[String])

  before_action :require_credit_authority

  # POST /review_passes
  # Opens a new pass. Any existing active pass for the
  # (actor, role, review_type, site) tuple is abandoned with
  # reason `superseded` so the new pass replaces it cleanly.
  #
  # DA-003 (analysis feedback) — derive and validate the
  # replacement membership BEFORE superseding the existing
  # active pass. The prior flow abandoned the active pass first
  # and then built units, so a request whose filtered projection
  # was empty destroyed resumable active work and opened an
  # unusable ended pass. Now an empty replacement is detected
  # up front and the existing active pass is left untouched
  # (still resumable), matching §6's "offered back" contract.
  sig { void }
  def create
    return head(:forbidden) unless %i[men dex].include?(current_active_role)

    review_type = params[:review_type].to_s
    return head(:bad_request) unless ALLOWED_REVIEW_TYPES.include?(review_type)
    origin = params[:origin].to_s
    return head(:bad_request) unless ALLOWED_ORIGINS.include?(origin)
    origin_path = sanitize_origin_path(params[:origin_path])

    acting_role = current_active_role
    site = current_active_site

    filters = sanitize_filters(params[:filters])
    units = build_units_for(review_type.to_sym, site: site, origin: origin, filters: filters)
    units = suffix_units_from_anchor(units, origin: origin, anchor_student_id: params[:anchor_student_id])

    existing = ReviewPass.active_for(actor: T.must(current_user), acting_role: T.must(acting_role), review_type: review_type.to_sym, site: site)

    # DA-003 (analysis feedback) — an empty replacement must not destroy
    # resumable active work. If the mentor already has an active pass for
    # this (role, review_type, site) and the new filtered projection is
    # empty, leave the existing pass untouched (still resumable) and
    # return the mentor to the origin so they can resume or adjust
    # filters. The prior flow abandoned the active pass first and then
    # discovered the empty membership, destroying resumable work without
    # opening a usable replacement. When there is no existing active pass,
    # an empty projection still records an ended empty pass so the mentor
    # sees the "nothing waiting" outcome rather than a silent no-op.
    if units.empty? && existing
      flash[:notice] = "No waiting work matches these filters. Your existing pass is still available."
      redirect_to origin_path || review_path
      return
    end

    ReviewPass.transaction do
      existing&.abandon!(reason: "superseded")

      pass = ReviewPass.create!(
        actor_id: T.must(current_user).id,
        site_id: site&.id || 0,
        acting_role: acting_role.to_s,
        review_type: review_type,
        origin: origin,
        origin_path: origin_path,
        filters: filters,
        total_units: 0,
        current_position: 0,
        ended: false
      )

      units.each_with_index do |attrs, idx|
        pass.review_pass_units.create!(
          unit_kind: attrs.fetch(:unit_kind),
          position: idx + 1,
          student_id: attrs[:student_id],
          submission_id: attrs[:submission_id],
          plan_id: attrs[:plan_id],
          plan_activity_id: attrs[:plan_activity_id]
        )
      end

      pass.update!(total_units: units.size)

      if units.empty?
        pass.update!(ended: true, ended_at: Time.current, ending_reason: "externally_completed")
        redirect_to origin_path || review_path
      else
        first = T.must(units.first)
        pass.update!(
          current_unit_kind: first.fetch(:unit_kind),
          current_unit_id: case first[:unit_kind]
                           when "student" then first[:student_id]
                           when "submission" then first[:submission_id]
                           when "plan" then first[:plan_id]
                           when "plan_activity" then first[:plan_activity_id]
                           else nil
                           end,
          current_position: 1
        )
        redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, first)
      end
    end
  end

  # GET /review_passes/:id
  # Resume a pass. Re-opens the current unit so a mentor can
  # bookmark or reload without losing the pass.
  sig { void }
  def show
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if unit.nil?
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
      return
    end

    redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/resume
  # Explicitly reactivates an abandoned pass for its owner. This preserves the
  # membership and current position captured when the pass began; completed
  # passes remain terminal.
  sig { void }
  def resume
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.resume!

    unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if unit
      redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    else
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
    end
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/skip
  # Skip current unit (does not record an outcome; moves the
  # unit to the end of the pass's visit order).
  sig { void }
  def skip
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    pass.skip_current!

    next_unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if next_unit
      redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, next_unit)
    else
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
    end
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/end_pass
  # Confirm end of a pass with units remaining. DA-003 (analysis
  # feedback) — this public endpoint is constrained to the ONE
  # client-initiated ending path from §6 ("the mentor confirms
  # leaving") and to an ACTIVE pass only. The other four ending
  # reasons are server-owned: `completed` and `all_skipped` are
  # derived in ReviewPass#advance! / #skip_current!,
  # `returned_to_students` is derived in the review-screen
  # outcome transitions, and `externally_completed` is derived
  # when remaining units are completed by other reviewers. The
  # prior implementation accepted every client-supplied
  # ENDING_REASONS value and rewrote inactive passes via #end!,
  # letting a caller claim a server-derived reason or rewrite a
  # terminal pass. Now only `confirmed_end` against an active
  # pass is honored; any other reason or an inactive pass is
  # rejected with 400 / 410 so the audit trail stays honest.
  sig { void }
  def end_pass
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    reason = params[:reason].to_s.presence || "confirmed_end"
    return head(:bad_request) unless reason == "confirmed_end"

    pass.abandon!(reason: reason)
    redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
  end

  # DELETE /review_passes/:id
  # Hard-reset (admin / out-of-band). Not normally used by the
  # mentor surfaces — the controllers themselves call
  # ReviewPass#advance! / #end! / #abandon! in-line so the
  # audit trail stays inside the decision rows.
  sig { void }
  def destroy
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id

    pass.abandon!(reason: "destroyed")
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  # Scope a pass by id + ownership. The id is opaque, the
  # ownership is the actor_id column. Returns nil for any
  # unknown id OR a pass that does not belong to the current
  # user — both surface as 404 so an attacker cannot enumerate
  # other mentors' passes.
  sig { returns(T.nilable(ReviewPass)) }
  def scoped_pass
    pass = ReviewPass.find_by(id: params[:id])
    return nil unless pass
    return nil unless pass.actor_id == T.must(current_user).id
    pass
  end

  # Sanitize the optional `return_path` param. Reject
  # absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, schemes, malformed
  # paths, and any path outside the allowlist. The allowlist
  # covers the seven screens in §5 plus the three review
  # screens which remain reachable as direct links.
  sig { params(path: T.nilable(T.any(String, Symbol))).returns(T.nilable(String)) }
  def sanitize_origin_path(path)
    return nil if path.blank?
    str = path.to_s
    return nil if str.include?("://") # reject absolute URLs
    return nil if str.start_with?("//") # reject protocol-relative
    return nil unless str.start_with?("/") # reject relative paths
    ALLOWED_RETURN_PATHS.find { |allowed| str == allowed || str.start_with?("#{allowed}/") || str.start_with?("#{allowed}?") }
  end

  sig { params(raw: T.nilable(Object)).returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Object]) }
  def sanitize_filters(raw)
    return {} if raw.blank?
    raw.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) ? raw.to_unsafe_h.slice(:class_id, :school_class_id, :round_id, :student_id, :status, :review_type, :sort).symbolize_keys : {}
  end

  # Build the unit list for the requested review_type. The
  # canonical waiting-set computation lives in the server-side scope and
  # filtered projection. Request parameters may describe filters and origin,
  # but never membership: a pass always freezes every currently eligible unit
  # in that authorized projection.
  sig do
    params(
      review_type: Symbol,
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      origin: String,
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_units_for(review_type, site:, origin:, filters:)
    case review_type
    when :plan
      build_plan_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :evidence
      build_evidence_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :final_product
      build_final_product_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :readiness
      build_readiness_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    else
      []
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_plan_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    plans = apply_pass_filters(
      scope.plans(status: :submitted_for_approval).where.not(mentor_example: true),
      filters: filters,
      review_type: :plan
    )
    # A DEX recommendation is that acting role's outcome. It remains waiting
    # work for MEN, but it must not be included in a fresh DEX pass.
    if current_active_role == :dex
      recommended_plan_ids = PlanSignoff.where(
        actor_role: "dex",
        action: PlanSignoff.actions.fetch("dex_pre_approval")
      ).select(:plan_id)
      plans = plans.where.not(id: recommended_plan_ids)
    end
    # A pass must visit plan units in the same order the filtered Students
    # projection shows. At minimum the explicit Student name sort is a
    # projection contract, not an implementation detail of the pass query;
    # ordering by plans.updated_at here made the first pass unit contradict
    # the visible roster order.
    plans = if filters[:sort].to_s == "name"
      # User's persisted roster name is the canonical sortable value. The
      # presentation helpers derive first/last segments from it, but those
      # segments are not database columns.
      plans.joins(:student).order("users.name ASC", "users.id ASC", "plans.id ASC")
    else
      plans.order(:updated_at, :id)
    end
    plans.pluck(:id, :student_id).map { |plan_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "plan", plan_id: plan_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_evidence_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.evidence, filters: filters, review_type: :evidence).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_final_product_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    role_tier = current_active_role == :men ? :grant : :recommendation
    reviewed_submission_ids = FinalProductReview.with_outcome.where(tier: role_tier).select(:submission_id)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.final_products.where.not(id: reviewed_submission_ids), filters: filters, review_type: :final_product).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_readiness_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    round = scope.current_signoff_round
    ids = round ? apply_pass_filters(scope.signoff_candidates(round: round), filters: filters, review_type: :readiness).pluck(:id) : []
    ids.map { |student_id| { unit_kind: "student", student_id: student_id } }
  end

  # The pass must capture only actionable units in the authorized filtered
  # projection. Statuses other than Waiting cannot create a pass.
  sig do
    params(
      relation: ActiveRecord::Relation,
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object],
      review_type: Symbol
    ).returns(ActiveRecord::Relation)
  end
  def apply_pass_filters(relation, filters:, review_type:)
    selected_type = filters[:review_type].to_s
    selected_status = filters[:status].to_s
    return relation.none if selected_type.present? && selected_type != review_type.to_s
    # A pass contains waiting units only. Other roster status filters are
    # useful for inspection but cannot legitimately start a waiting pass.
    return relation.none if selected_status.present? && selected_status != "waiting"

    if review_type == :readiness
      relation = relation.where(id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      class_filter_id = filters[:school_class_id].presence || filters[:class_id]
      if class_filter_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
        enrolled_ids = Enrollment.active_on(current_active_site&.today || Date.current, site: current_active_site)
                                .where(school_class_id: class_filter_id.to_s.to_i)
                                .select(:student_id)
        relation = relation.where(id: enrolled_ids)
      end
      return relation.where(id: Plan.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i).select(:student_id)) if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

      return relation
    end

    relation = relation.where(student_id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
    if filters[:class_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(plans: { school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(rounds: { id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    relation
  end


  # A waiting roster cell starts at its own student and retains only the
  # projection suffix after it. The request may name the anchor student but
  # never pass ids or membership; membership/order remain server-derived.
  sig do
    params(
      units: T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]],
      origin: String,
      anchor_student_id: T.nilable(Object)
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def suffix_units_from_anchor(units, origin:, anchor_student_id:)
    return units unless %w[students_cell cell_pass].include?(origin)
    return [] unless anchor_student_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

    anchor_id = anchor_student_id.to_s.to_i
    anchor_index = units.index { |unit| unit_student_id(unit) == anchor_id }
    anchor_index ? units.drop(anchor_index) : []
  end

  sig { params(unit: T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]).returns(T.nilable(Integer)) }
  def unit_student_id(unit)
    unit[:student_id]
  end

  sig do
    params(
      pass: ReviewPass,
      unit: T.any(T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)], ReviewPassUnit)
    ).returns(String)
  end
  def decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    unit_kind = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:unit_kind] : unit.unit_kind
    plan_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:plan_id] : unit.plan_id
    submission_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:submission_id] : unit.submission_id
    student_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:student_id] : unit.student_id

    base = case pass.review_type
    when "plan" then "/review/plans"
    when "evidence" then "/review"
    when "final_product" then "/review/final-products"
    when "readiness" then "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio"
    else "/students"
    end

    case unit_kind
    when "plan"
      "/review/plans/#{plan_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    when "submission"
      if pass.review_type == "final_product"
        "/review/final-products/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      else
        "/review/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      end
    when "student"
      "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    else
      base
    end
  end
end

    if unit.nil?
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
      return
    end

    redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/resume
  # Explicitly reactivates an abandoned pass for its owner. This preserves the
  # membership and current position captured when the pass began; completed
  # passes remain terminal.
  sig { void }
  def resume
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.resume!

    unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if unit
      redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    else
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
    end
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/skip
  # Skip current unit (does not record an outcome; moves the
  # unit to the end of the pass's visit order).
  sig { void }
  def skip
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    pass.skip_current!

    next_unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if next_unit
      redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, next_unit)
    else
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
    end
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/end_pass
  # Confirm end of a pass with units remaining. DA-003 (analysis
  # feedback) — this public endpoint is constrained to the ONE
  # client-initiated ending path from §6 ("the mentor confirms
  # leaving") and to an ACTIVE pass only. The other four ending
  # reasons are server-owned: `completed` and `all_skipped` are
  # derived in ReviewPass#advance! / #skip_current!,
  # `returned_to_students` is derived in the review-screen
  # outcome transitions, and `externally_completed` is derived
  # when remaining units are completed by other reviewers. The
  # prior implementation accepted every client-supplied
  # ENDING_REASONS value and rewrote inactive passes via #end!,
  # letting a caller claim a server-derived reason or rewrite a
  # terminal pass. Now only `confirmed_end` against an active
  # pass is honored; any other reason or an inactive pass is
  # rejected with 400 / 410 so the audit trail stays honest.
  sig { void }
  def end_pass
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    reason = params[:reason].to_s.presence || "confirmed_end"
    return head(:bad_request) unless reason == "confirmed_end"

    pass.abandon!(reason: reason)
    redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
  end

  # DELETE /review_passes/:id
  # Hard-reset (admin / out-of-band). Not normally used by the
  # mentor surfaces — the controllers themselves call
  # ReviewPass#advance! / #end! / #abandon! in-line so the
  # audit trail stays inside the decision rows.
  sig { void }
  def destroy
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id

    pass.abandon!(reason: "destroyed")
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  # Scope a pass by id + ownership. The id is opaque, the
  # ownership is the actor_id column. Returns nil for any
  # unknown id OR a pass that does not belong to the current
  # user — both surface as 404 so an attacker cannot enumerate
  # other mentors' passes.
  sig { returns(T.nilable(ReviewPass)) }
  def scoped_pass
    pass = ReviewPass.find_by(id: params[:id])
    return nil unless pass
    return nil unless pass.actor_id == T.must(current_user).id
    pass
  end

  # Sanitize the optional `return_path` param. Reject
  # absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, schemes, malformed
  # paths, and any path outside the allowlist. The allowlist
  # covers the seven screens in §5 plus the three review
  # screens which remain reachable as direct links.
  sig { params(path: T.nilable(T.any(String, Symbol))).returns(T.nilable(String)) }
  def sanitize_origin_path(path)
    return nil if path.blank?
    str = path.to_s
    return nil if str.include?("://") # reject absolute URLs
    return nil if str.start_with?("//") # reject protocol-relative
    return nil unless str.start_with?("/") # reject relative paths
    ALLOWED_RETURN_PATHS.find { |allowed| str == allowed || str.start_with?("#{allowed}/") || str.start_with?("#{allowed}?") }
  end

  sig { params(raw: T.nilable(Object)).returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Object]) }
  def sanitize_filters(raw)
    return {} if raw.blank?
    raw.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) ? raw.to_unsafe_h.slice(:class_id, :school_class_id, :round_id, :student_id, :status, :review_type, :sort).symbolize_keys : {}
  end

  # Build the unit list for the requested review_type. The
  # canonical waiting-set computation lives in the server-side scope and
  # filtered projection. Request parameters may describe filters and origin,
  # but never membership: a pass always freezes every currently eligible unit
  # in that authorized projection.
  sig do
    params(
      review_type: Symbol,
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      origin: String,
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_units_for(review_type, site:, origin:, filters:)
    case review_type
    when :plan
      build_plan_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :evidence
      build_evidence_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :final_product
      build_final_product_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    when :readiness
      build_readiness_units(site: site, filters: filters)
    else
      []
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_plan_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    plans = apply_pass_filters(
      scope.plans(status: :submitted_for_approval).where.not(mentor_example: true),
      filters: filters,
      review_type: :plan
    )
    # A DEX recommendation is that acting role's outcome. It remains waiting
    # work for MEN, but it must not be included in a fresh DEX pass.
    if current_active_role == :dex
      recommended_plan_ids = PlanSignoff.where(
        actor_role: "dex",
        action: PlanSignoff.actions.fetch("dex_pre_approval")
      ).select(:plan_id)
      plans = plans.where.not(id: recommended_plan_ids)
    end
    # A pass must visit plan units in the same order the filtered Students
    # projection shows. At minimum the explicit Student name sort is a
    # projection contract, not an implementation detail of the pass query;
    # ordering by plans.updated_at here made the first pass unit contradict
    # the visible roster order.
    plans = if filters[:sort].to_s == "name"
      # User's persisted roster name is the canonical sortable value. The
      # presentation helpers derive first/last segments from it, but those
      # segments are not database columns.
      plans.joins(:student).order("users.name ASC", "users.id ASC", "plans.id ASC")
    else
      plans.order(:updated_at, :id)
    end
    plans.pluck(:id, :student_id).map { |plan_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "plan", plan_id: plan_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_evidence_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.evidence, filters: filters, review_type: :evidence).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_final_product_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    role_tier = current_active_role == :men ? :grant : :recommendation
    reviewed_submission_ids = FinalProductReview.with_outcome.where(tier: role_tier).select(:submission_id)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.final_products.where.not(id: reviewed_submission_ids), filters: filters, review_type: :final_product).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_readiness_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    round = scope.current_signoff_round
    ids = round ? apply_pass_filters(scope.signoff_candidates(round: round), filters: filters, review_type: :readiness).pluck(:id) : []
    ids.map { |student_id| { unit_kind: "student", student_id: student_id } }
  end

  # The pass must capture only actionable units in the authorized filtered
  # projection. Statuses other than Waiting cannot create a pass.
  sig do
    params(
      relation: ActiveRecord::Relation,
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object],
      review_type: Symbol
    ).returns(ActiveRecord::Relation)
  end
  def apply_pass_filters(relation, filters:, review_type:)
    selected_type = filters[:review_type].to_s
    selected_status = filters[:status].to_s
    return relation.none if selected_type.present? && selected_type != review_type.to_s
    # A pass contains waiting units only. Other roster status filters are
    # useful for inspection but cannot legitimately start a waiting pass.
    return relation.none if selected_status.present? && selected_status != "waiting"

    if review_type == :readiness
      relation = relation.where(id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      class_filter_id = filters[:school_class_id].presence || filters[:class_id]
      if class_filter_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
        enrolled_ids = Enrollment.active_on(current_active_site&.today || Date.current, site: current_active_site)
                                .where(school_class_id: class_filter_id.to_s.to_i)
                                .select(:student_id)
        relation = relation.where(id: enrolled_ids)
      end
      return relation.where(id: Plan.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i).select(:student_id)) if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

      return relation
    end

    relation = relation.where(student_id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
    if filters[:class_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(plans: { school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(rounds: { id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    relation
  end


  # A waiting roster cell starts at its own student and retains only the
  # projection suffix after it. The request may name the anchor student but
  # never pass ids or membership; membership/order remain server-derived.
  sig do
    params(
      units: T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]],
      origin: String,
      anchor_student_id: T.nilable(Object)
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def suffix_units_from_anchor(units, origin:, anchor_student_id:)
    return units unless %w[students_cell cell_pass].include?(origin)
    return [] unless anchor_student_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

    anchor_id = anchor_student_id.to_s.to_i
    anchor_index = units.index { |unit| unit_student_id(unit) == anchor_id }
    anchor_index ? units.drop(anchor_index) : []
  end

  sig { params(unit: T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]).returns(T.nilable(Integer)) }
  def unit_student_id(unit)
    unit[:student_id]
  end

  sig do
    params(
      pass: ReviewPass,
      unit: T.any(T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)], ReviewPassUnit)
    ).returns(String)
  end
  def decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    unit_kind = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:unit_kind] : unit.unit_kind
    plan_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:plan_id] : unit.plan_id
    submission_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:submission_id] : unit.submission_id
    student_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:student_id] : unit.student_id

    base = case pass.review_type
    when "plan" then "/review/plans"
    when "evidence" then "/review"
    when "final_product" then "/review/final-products"
    when "readiness" then "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio"
    else "/students"
    end

    case unit_kind
    when "plan"
      "/review/plans/#{plan_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    when "submission"
      if pass.review_type == "final_product"
        "/review/final-products/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      else
        "/review/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      end
    when "student"
      "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    else
      base
    end
  end
end

{"path": "app/controllers/staff/students_controller.rb", "content": "      # WT-15 / AC-06 — paged scope + per-page selector so a 200+ student
      # mentor roster does not render as an unbounded 200+ row table.
      # The metric counts (AM / PM / MT) stay above the filter so the
      # operator sees the full population regardless of the page window.
      # The roster renders the projection rows, not the older @students
      # relation. Paginating that relation left later roster rows visible and
      # made the footer a status-only dead end. Page the canonical projection
      # so the visible rows, count, and links describe the same population.
      requested_per_page = params[:per_page].presence&.to_i || PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE
      requested_per_page = PaginationHelper::DEFAULT_PER_PAGE if requested_per_page < 1
      @per_page = [ requested_per_page, PaginationHelper::MAX_PER_PAGE ].min
      total_count = @roster_rows.size
      total_pages = total_count.zero? ? 1 : (total_count.to_f / @per_page).ceil
      @page = [ [ params[:page].to_i, 1 ].max, total_pages ].min
      offset = (@page - 1) * @per_page
      @roster_rows = @roster_rows.slice(offset, @per_page) || []
      @pagination = {
        records: User.none,
        page: @page,

      uri = URI.parse(origin)
      return nil unless uri.relative? && uri.path == students_path && uri.fragment.nil?

      pairs = URI.decode_www_form(uri.query.to_s)
      allowed_keys = %w[class_id round_id student_id review_type status sort page per_page].freeze
      return nil unless pairs.all? { |key, value| allowed_keys.include?(key) && value.is_a?(String) }
      return nil unless pairs.map(&:first).uniq.length == pairs.length

      origin
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError, ArgumentError
      nil
    end

    sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, String]) }
    def effective_roster_filters
      keys = %w[class_id round_id student_id review_type status sort].freeze
      if params[:clear_filters].present?
        session.delete(:students_roster_filters)
        return {}
      end

      supplied = params.permit(*keys).to_h.compact_blank
      stored = session[:students_roster_filters]
      stored_hash = stored.is_a?(Hash) ? stored.slice(*keys) : {}
      effective = supplied.present? ? supplied : stored_hash
      session[:students_roster_filters] = effective if supplied.present?
      effective.symbolize_keys
    end
  end
end

{"path": "app/controllers/application_controller.rb", "content": "  sig { void }
  def require_student
    return if current_student
    redirect_to login_redirect_path, alert: "Please sign in as a student."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_staff
    if current_staff
      # The session-stored active role may already be a staff
      # role (the UserRole chain is intact) BUT the actor's
      # PERSISTED role column may be :stu — a recovery actor
      # whose persisted role was downgraded by the spec 01
      # revocation safety net. We still accept the request
      # because the live UserRole grant authorizes the action;
      # no scope-side redirect fires.
      return true
    end
    # Inactive / revoked staff role — record a permission-denied
    # event so a SUP can audit the rejection (RP-33). The dedupe
    # window keeps a bot probing the same URL from spamming the
    # table. Audit §5.4 closure: route to /denied (role-aware
    # screen) instead of the staff login — the staff login implies
    # "you're not signed in", which is misleading for an
    # authenticated actor with the wrong role.
    record_permission_denied_event("require_staff", reason: "active role not in staff cluster")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Please sign in as a mentor or admin."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_admin
    return if %i[dex sup].include?(current_active_role)
    record_permission_denied_event("require_admin")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Admin sign-in required."
  end

  # SUP-only gate. Extracted to ApplicationController so the
  # five new settings controllers (AI settings, super-admins,
  # rubric config, schedules config, settings hub) do NOT
  # duplicate the private require_sup method that previously
  # lived in Admin::RepairsController and
  # Admin::Settings::TimeValueGuidesController. The shared gate
  # is the canonical enforcement point — adding a new SUP-only
  # surface only requires `before_action :require_sup` in the
  # controller header. Redirects to admin_settings_path (the
  # SUP landing hub) so the operator gets the closest
  # SUP-accessible surface rather than the generic admin
  # dashboard.
  sig { void }
  def require_sup
    return if current_active_role == :sup
    record_permission_denied_event("require_sup", reason: "active role is not :sup")
    flash[:alert] = "#{SiteScopeResolver.role_label(:sup)} sign-in required"
    redirect_to denied_path
  end

  # Site selection is an administrative scope change, not a generic staff
  # action. Enforce the same SUP/DEX boundary as the picker so a forged POST
  # cannot activate a site for MEN or CON roles hidden by the UI.
  sig { void }
  def require_sup_or_dex
    return if %i[sup dex].include?(current_active_role)
    record_permission_denied_event("require_sup_or_dex", reason: "active role is not :sup or :dex")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Dean or admin sign-in required."
  end

  # Credit-authority gate per spec 01 §6: /review is the C9-C14
  # credit-authority surface. Routine credit-bearing review is
  # reserved for MEN/DEX only. Contractors (:con) are NOT in the
  # credit-authority cluster — they monitor / support students
  # but cannot grant credit. Super-admins (:sup) may only affect
  # credit through explicit repair/admin pathways (RC-65), not
  # through the routine review machinery. We gate the review
  # surface on the ACTIVE (role) tuple so a contractor or
  # super-admin backed by an admin account (or a user who
  # switched into :con via RP-W3) is redirected off /review
  # back to the staff login. Note (TJ-S62): SUP is admitted to
  # the SHOW action ONLY — the operational inspection
  # (read-only, audit-logged) surface. MEN / DEX continue to
  # handle credit-bearing actions like approve / needs_revision.
  # A multi-role SUP who is currently switched into :men or
  # :dex falls through the men/dex branch and writes NO
  # OperationalInspectionAccess row (RC-65).
  sig { void }

  # Contractor gate per spec 01 §6 + EV-W7/EV-W8 (AC-01, AC-02).
  # The /support daily-monitoring + per-student support surface
  # is RESERVED for contractors (:con). Mentors / deans /
  # super-admins who land on /support (a stale deep-link, an
  # accidental role-switch, or the post-rebrand navigation
  # drift the AC-01 spec called out) are redirected to the
  # staff login so the contractor-only "monitoring / support
  # only" framing of the surface stays intact. Students never
  # reach this branch (require_authentication already redirects
  # them; require_contractor redirects a contractor-less staff
  # actor without leaking any contractor-scoped data).
  sig { void }
  def require_contractor
    return if current_active_role == :con
    record_permission_denied_event("require_contractor", reason: "active role is not :con")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Contractor sign-in required."
  end

  sig { returns(String) }
  def login_redirect_path
    path = request.path
    if path.start_with?("/admin", "/review", "/staff", "/students", "/role_switches", "/site_switches")
      staff_login_path
    else
      student_login_path
    end
  end

  # Request-integrity failures are recoverable user-facing conditions, not
  # application errors. In particular, a stale CSRF token frequently means a
  # session expired while a form was open. Clear the unusable session and send
  # the person to the appropriate sign-in page without implying their action
  # completed. This deliberately covers only request/session exceptions;
  # programming errors remain visible to Rails logging and the static fallback.
  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(Exception)).void }
  def render_session_recovery(_error = nil)
    reset_session
    redirect_to login_redirect_path,
                alert: "Your session has expired. Please sign in and try again."
  end

  # An action can deliberately raise BadRequest for invalid user input. That
  # does not prove the session expired, so preserve the valid tuple and render
  # a non-technical recovery page rather than signing the person out.
  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(ActionController::BadRequest)).void }
  def render_static_bad_request(_error = nil)
    render file: Rails.public_path.join("400.html"),
           content_type: "text/html",
           layout: false,
           status: :bad_request
  end

  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound)).void }
  def render_not_found(_error = nil)
    if current_student
      redirect_to denied_path, alert: "That page isn't part of your plan."
    else
      render file: Rails.public_path.join("404.html"),
             content_type: "text/html",
             layout: false,
             status: :not_found
    end
